reference_roles: 游戏截图：场景与已有美术风格

prompts.a:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity in-game HUD visual reference for a Chinese fairy-tale side-scrolling witch shooter, landscape phone. Generate ONE finished full-screen landscape gameplay screenshot, approximately 2160 x 1000 (same aspect as 844x390), no device frame, no surrounding board, no annotation arrows, no website.
Input images: image1 is a gameplay scene/style reference ONLY, replace all its old UI; image2 is the exact heroine identity/style reference, omit green background; image3 is ONLY a layout wireframe reference, never reproduce its crude shapes or explanatory footer.
Keep the established softly painted night village and lake, layered muted violet mountains, large warm pale moon, tiny lit cottage windows. Heroine at x30%,y52% has cream floppy witch hat with blue bow and cute face, blonde twin braids, dark purple dress, blue neck bow, rides broom facing right, her whole silhouette visible. At x73%,y51% a woolly round gray night-monster boss from image1 with a pale face and small lamp motif, full silhouette within central playfield. A few white small star shots and a sparse clearly legible group of pink enemy bullets. UI is the main design task; do not turn the scene into promotional illustration. Preserve handmade watercolor cutout art, no realistic 3D.
Composition/function contracts: continuous full-screen background; entirely invisible structural margins; live action protected roughly x14%-83%, y23%-76%; controls in side/lower peripheral zones, never obscure hero, bullets or enemy. Safe blank edge margins for landscape phone notch, about 5% of screen width left and right, 3% height top and bottom. No opaque bottom strip. UI must be legible at actual 844x390 CSS size, short high contrast Chinese labels, readable figures.
Top-left: exactly four filled pink hearts and one dim heart, then a small second line label "射击 L3" with one tiny pale-gold shooting-growth progress bar. Top-center: one short Boss name "湖边大夜怪", directly below a SINGLE slim coral health bar about 34% screen width, two visible phase tick marks at 1/3 and2/3, current phase short text "聚雾". Top-right: a single pause button with two bars, no always-visible score or seconds.
Bottom-left: one translucent thumb joystick, center at x9%,y79%, outer diameter about16% screen height, subtle inner thumb.
Right peripheral skill group: EXACTLY TWO large touch buttons, vertically aligned at x90%, centers y59% and80%, each diameter/height about15% screen height (around58CSSpx at390high). Top one is FIRE, lower one BLOOM. Top fire button contains a simple orange flame icon, Chinese "炉火", and "2/3" ALL INSIDE the SAME button. Lower bloom contains a clear five-point star-flower icon, Chinese "绽放", and "就绪" ALL INSIDE the SAME button; its perimeter energy ring full. They form an obvious aligned pair. No extra action button, no attack button (touch auto-fire), no skill selection, no MP/mana bar, no elemental cards, no inventory anywhere else. No labels floating outside either skill button. Do not add title/logo, menu, settings gears, currency, portraits, extra ability, tutorial or key labels.
Text verbatim only: "射击 L3", "湖边大夜怪", "聚雾", "炉火", "2/3", "绽放", "就绪". Pause uses icon only.
Visual direction A: restrained moonlit glass and soft starlight, transparent smoky-indigo UI surfaces, muted cream outlines, tiny rounded highlights, no large panels. Floating circular skill medallions: fire rim warm amber, bloom rim pale icy-blue/lavender. Both very crisp with simple chunky icons, small controlled glow, subdued outer shadows; decorative stars no bigger than a few pixels, no ornate flourishes. Heart cluster and L3 are lightweight unboxed typography in upper left. Boss name sits on a tiny translucent pill; health line is clean and narrow below. Pause thin outlined circular button. Joystick subdued lilac glass. The screen should feel airy, uncluttered and beautiful, gameplay is still readable. Designer-polished shipped mobile-game HUD, clearly distinguish frame borders from bullets, no heavy bloom.
